|errata_history=This is the original printed text of [[Understand Art, Understand A Species]] (version 1 of 2). The image here is the Players Committee card image as first published (10 August 2022). The current text is [[Understand Art, Understand A Species (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source.
* '''Original''' (this page): Virtual Set 19 release; card image first published 10 August 2022<ref name="img-o-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Dark/large/understandartunderstandaspecies.gif</code> as published 10 August 2022: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25528d7b73b5e6206de765d700504be693fc39da/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/understandartunderstandaspecies.gif holotable commit 25528d7] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “USED: Target a character in battle. Target and opponent's cards that share any characteristic(s) with it are power and forfeit -1. LOST: Once per game, if your [Set 19] objective just 'studied' a character, add one battle destiny (two if a character of same species is in battle).” The PC card data's errata note quotes the original as “Target and cards that share any characteristic with target …” and “studied” without “just”; the published image prints “Target and opponent's cards that share any characteristic(s) with it …” and “just 'studied'”, which is followed here.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Understand Art, Understand A Species (Errata)]]): Card image published as a high-resolution PNG on 7 March 2026 at 20:10:02 UTC.<ref name="pc-first-png-2026-understandartunderstandaspecies">Players Committee Holotable repository, [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/hires/understandartunderstandaspecies.png published PNG], [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/23b4dc91123cec2827f5084f60e2378f88594306 commit 23b4dc9], 7 March 2026, 20:10:02 UTC.</ref> The GIF cited below was published on 9 March 2026 at 00:26:25 UTC and displays the same pixels. The current [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/Set19Type.html Virtual Set 19 card list]<ref name="img-PC-E1-0">Players Committee card image <code>Virtual19-Dark/large/understandartunderstandaspecies.gif</code> as published 9 March 2026: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6f23e077ed3f1bb8f34b62099641028868d7a2ae/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual19-Dark/large/understandartunderstandaspecies.gif holotable commit 6f23e07] (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards).</ref>: “If an Imperial leader just won a battle, opponent loses 1 Force (and stacks it on Thrawn's Art Collection if possible). OR Suspend Ancient Watering Hole for remainder of turn. OR If you have 4 artwork cards, you retrieve 1 Force and opponent loses 1 Force.” '''What changed:''' Game text: “USED: Target” became “If an Imperial leader just won”; “character in battle. Target” became “battle, opponent loses 1 Force (and stacks it on Thrawn's Art Collection if possible). OR Suspend Ancient Watering Hole for remainder of turn. OR If you have 4 artwork cards, you retrieve 1 Force”; “opponent's cards that share any characteristic(s) with it are power and forfeit -1. LOST: Once per game, if your [Set 19] objective just 'studied' a character, add one battle destiny (two if a character of same species is in battle).” became “opponent loses 1 Force.” The card type line changed from “Used Or Lost Interrupt” to “Used Interrupt”.
